req.title: Cookie name path segment escaping
req.statement: The system shall percent-decode the <name> and <value> path segments in /cookies/set/<name>/<value>.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that /cookies/set/<name>/<value> must percent-decode the name and value path segments. Flask/Werkzeug handles URL decoding of path segments automatically, so the set_cookie handler receives already-decoded strings. Tests must verify: (1) a normal cookie name/value is set correctly (EP positive), (2) a percent-encoded name/value is decoded and set correctly (EP positive with encoding), (3) a percent-encoded space (%20) in name and value is decoded to a literal space (BVA), (4) a percent-encoded special character like %2F (slash) is decoded (BVA boundary), (5) an empty-string-equivalent or single-char boundary name (BVA), and (6) a cookie name with percent-encoded characters that would be invalid if not decoded (NEG/DT). We drive the Flask test client in follow_redirects=True mode so we can inspect the final /cookies JSON payload, confirming the decoded name and value appear. We also check the redirect response (302) without following to confirm the Set-Cookie header contains the decoded values.

tests.name: test_set_cookie_plain_name_value_positive
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
expected: HTTP 200 response
JSON body contains cookies dict with key 'mycookie' equal to 'myvalue'
trace: R-HTTPBIN-044: plain name/value path segments are passed through and set as cookie
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_plain_name_value_positive():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/mycookie/myvalue', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert data['cookies']['mycookie'] == 'myvalue'

test_set_cookie_plain_name_value_positive()

tests.name: test_set_cookie_redirect_sets_cookie_header
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
expected: HTTP 302 response
Set-Cookie header contains 'alpha' as cookie name
Set-Cookie header contains 'beta!' as decoded value (not 'beta%21')
trace: R-HTTPBIN-044: the redirect response must carry a Set-Cookie header with decoded value
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_redirect_sets_cookie_header():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/alpha/beta%21', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    set_cookie = r.headers.get('Set-Cookie', '')
    assert 'alpha' in set_cookie
    assert 'beta!' in set_cookie
    assert 'beta%21' not in set_cookie

test_set_cookie_redirect_sets_cookie_header()

from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_single_char_name_boundary():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/a/z', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert 'a' in data['cookies']

client = app.test_client()

    assert r.status_code == 405
    assert r.status_code != 200

tests.name: test_set_cookie_response_redirects_to_view_cookies
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
expected: HTTP 302 response
Location header equals '/cookies'
trace: R-HTTPBIN-044: after setting cookie, endpoint must redirect to /cookies (view_cookies)
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_response_redirects_to_view_cookies():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/x/y', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert location == '/cookies'
    assert location != '/cookies/set/x/y'
    assert location != '/'

test_set_cookie_response_redirects_to_view_cookies()
